g.text: What each paper actually contributes to GNC
Separate guidance, estimation, feedback, allocation and experimental evidence; do not treat “MPC” and “GNC” as competing categories.
Same seven papers as the map. Presence of an estimator does not imply navigation novelty. Read the paper-specific source locators in TVC_Research_Notes.md.
